40019704.author: पदार्थः
40019704.content: कैकेय्यानन्दवर्धनः enhancer of Kaikeyi's joy, भरतः Bharata, शिरसि head, अञ्जलिम् folded hands, आधाय submitted, सत्यपराक्रमम् unfailing valour, ज्येष्ठम् to elder, रामम् Rama, बभाषे spoke

40019704.author: Translation
40019704.content: Bharata, the enhancer of Kaikeyi's joy, of unfailing valour, with folded palms on head submitted to his elder brother.

40019705.author: पदार्थः
40019705.content: मामिका mine, माता mother, पूजिता worshipped, इदंराज्यम् this kingdom, मम myself, दत्तम् bestowed, तत् that, त्वम् to you, मम me, यथा as it is, आददाः returning, पुनः again, तुभ्यम् and now, ददामि giving

40019705.author: Translation
40019705.content: "This kingdom was bestowed on me and my mother. I return it back to you now again."

40019706.author: पदार्थः
40019706.content: बलीयसा strong, एकाकिना alone, वृषभेण young ox, न्यस्ताम् transferred to, धुरम् burden, किशोरवत् like young, गुरुम् heavy, भारम् burden, अहम् I, वोढुम् bull, न उत्सहे not able to bear

40019706.author: Translation
40019706.content: "I am not able to bear the heavy burden transferred to me any more like a young ox can't bear like a bull.

40019707.author: पदार्थः
40019707.content: महता great, वारिवेगेन strong rush of water, भिन्नः breached, क्षरन् have no effect, सेतुरिव like dam, इदम् this, राज्यच्छ्रिदम् kingdom containing vulnerable points, असम्वृतम् not protected well, दुर्बन्धम् difficult, मन्ये I think

40019707.author: Translation
40019707.content: "If the kingdom containing vulnerable points is not protected on all sides, it can't stand, just as a strong rush of water can be prevented from breach only by constructing a dam.

40019708.author: पदार्थः
40019708.content: खरइवा like donkey, गतिं not go, श्वस्य horse, हंसस्येव च and like swan च वायसः crow not run, अरिन्दम tormentor of enemies, तव your, मार्गम् way, अन्वेतुम्, राम Rama, न उत्सहे not able to नान्वेतु like you

40019708.author: Translation
40019708.content: "O Rama! Donkey can't run like horse crow can't run like swan. I am not able to bear the burden of kingdom like you, O tormentor of enemies."

40019709.author: पदार्थः
40019709.content: अन्नर्निवेशने your own house, आरोपितः to climb, वृक्षः tree, महान् huge, दुरारोहः difficult to climb, महास्कन्दः large trunk, प्रशाखवान् many branches, जातःअसि born, पुष्पितःभूत्वा after flowering, फलानि fruits, न प्रदर्शयन् not yield, यथा so also, शीर्येत withered, सः he, यस्यहेतोः the cause, रोपितः planted, तस्य his, अर्थम् meaning, नानुभवेत् will not enjoy, एषा in that way, उपमा example, महाबाहो mighty armed, मनुजेन्द्र ruler of the people, त्वम् you, भर्ता rule, भृत्यान् dependants, नः not, न शाधियदिहि not take care, त्वम् you, अर्थम् understand, वेत्तुम् solicit, अर्हसि ought

40019709.author: Translation
40019709.content: "If for example you have planted a tree in your own house, it becomes huge and difficult to climb in spite of a large trunk, many branches and after flowering does not yield fruits and is withered, the person who planted will not enjoy the fruit. In that way O mighty armed Rama, you are the ruler of the people, if you would not take care of us, your dependants, I solicit you ought to understand what I mean.

40019710.author: पदार्थः
40019710.content: अन्नर्निवेशने your own house, आरोपितः to climb, वृक्षः tree, महान् huge, दुरारोहः difficult to climb, महास्कन्दः large trunk, प्रशाखवान् many branches, जातःअसि born, पुष्पितःभूत्वा after flowering, फलानि fruits, न प्रदर्शयन् not yield, यथा so also, शीर्येत withered, सः he, यस्यहेतोः the cause, रोपितः planted, तस्य his, अर्थम् meaning, नानुभवेत् will not enjoy, एषा in that way, उपमा example, महाबाहो mighty armed, मनुजेन्द्र ruler of the people, त्वम् you, भर्ता rule, भृत्यान् dependants, नः not, न शाधियदिहि not take care, त्वम् you, अर्थम् understand, वेत्तुम् solicit, अर्हसि ought

40019710.author: Translation
40019710.content: "If for example you have planted a tree in your own house, it becomes huge and difficult to climb in spite of a large trunk, many branches and after flowering does not yield fruits and is withered, the person who planted will not enjoy the fruit. In that way O mighty armed Rama, you are the ruler of the people, if you would not take care of us, your dependants, I solicit you ought to understand what I mean.

40019711.author: पदार्थः
40019711.content: अन्नर्निवेशने your own house, आरोपितः to climb, वृक्षः tree, महान् huge, दुरारोहः difficult to climb, महास्कन्दः large trunk, प्रशाखवान् many branches, जातःअसि born, पुष्पितःभूत्वा after flowering, फलानि fruits, न प्रदर्शयन् not yield, यथा so also, शीर्येत withered, सः he, यस्यहेतोः the cause, रोपितः planted, तस्य his, अर्थम् meaning, नानुभवेत् will not enjoy, एषा in that way, उपमा example, महाबाहो mighty armed, मनुजेन्द्र ruler of the people, त्वम् you, भर्ता rule, भृत्यान् dependants, नः not, न शाधियदिहि not take care, त्वम् you, अर्थम् understand, वेत्तुम् solicit, अर्हसि ought

40019711.author: Translation
40019711.content: "If for example you have planted a tree in your own house, it becomes huge and difficult to climb in spite of a large trunk, many branches and after flowering does not yield fruits and is withered, the person who planted will not enjoy the fruit. In that way O mighty armed Rama, you are the ruler of the people, if you would not take care of us, your dependants, I solicit you ought to understand what I mean.

40019712.author: पदार्थः
40019712.content: राघव Raghava, जगत् world, अद्य today, अभिषिक्तम् consecration, त्वाम् you, मध्याह्ने in the afternoon, प्रतपन्तम् dazzling, दीप्ततेजसम् in brilliance, आदित्यमिव like the sun, अनुपश्यतु see you

40019712.author: Translation
40019712.content: "Raghava, let you be consecrated in the afternoon and the world will see you dazzling in brilliance like the sun today."

40019713.author: पदार्थः
40019713.content: तूर्यसङ्घान्तिर्घोषैः sounds of musical instruments, काञ्चीनूपुरनिःस्वनैः tinkling of ornaments strung with tiny bells, मधुरैः sweet, गीतशब्दैश्च sounds of singing, प्रतिबुध्यस्व worn around waist and anklets, शेष्व च and sweet

40019713.author: Translation
40019713.content: May you wake up to the sounds of musical instruments and the tinkling of ornaments worn around the waist and anklets and sweet sounds of singing.

40019714.author: पदार्थः
40019714.content: चक्रम् stellar sphere, यावत् as long as, आवर्तते goes round, वसुन्धरा earth, यावत् that long, तावत् till then, इह here, लोकस्य in the world, स्वामित्वम् rulership, अनुवर्तय revolves

40019714.author: Translation
40019714.content: As long as the stellar sphere goes round, and as long as the earth revolves around that long you enjoy the rulership of the world."

40019715.author: पदार्थः
40019715.content: परपुरञ्जयः conqueror of enemies, रामः Rama, भरतस्य Bharata's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, तथेति be it so, प्रतिजग्राह replied, शुभे auspicious, आसने seat, निषषाद seated

40019715.author: Translation
40019715.content: Hearing Bharata's words, the conqueror of enemies, Rama said 'Be it so'. Then Bharata took the auspicious seat.

40019716.author: पदार्थः
40019716.content: ततः then, शत्रुघ्नवचनात् Shatrughna's words, निपुणाः expert, सुखहस्ताः skilled at hand, सुशीघ्राश्च hastily, श्मश्रुवर्धनाः soft skilled, राघवम् Raghava, पर्यवारयन् surrounded

40019716.author: Translation
40019716.content: Then at the command of Shatrughna's words, experts with hand work (barbers) who had soft skills quickly surrounded Raghava.

40019717.author: पदार्थः
40019717.content: पूर्वम् first, भरते Bharata, स्नाते had bath, महाबले mighty, लक्ष्मणे च Lakshmana also, वानरेन्द्रे Vanara king, सुग्रीवे Sugriva, राक्षसेन्द्रे Rakshasa king, विभीषणे Vibheeshana, विशोधितजटः removed the matted hair, स्नातः had bath, चित्रमाल्यानुलेपनः adorned with colourful garlands and daubed with sandal paste, महार्हवसनोपेतः clothed in exquisite robes, तत्र then, श्रिया shining, ज्वलन् glowing, तस्थौ stood

40019717.author: Translation
40019717.content: Bharata had his bath first, and mighty Lakshmana, Sugriva the monkey king, and Vibheeshana the Rakshasa king followed him. Sri Rama removed the matted hair, had bath, adorned with colourful garlands, and daubed with sandal paste and clothed in exquisite robes stood glowing and shining.

40019718.author: पदार्थः
40019718.content: पूर्वम् first, भरते Bharata, स्नाते had bath, महाबले mighty, लक्ष्मणे च Lakshmana also, वानरेन्द्रे Vanara king, सुग्रीवे Sugriva, राक्षसेन्द्रे Rakshasa king, विभीषणे Vibheeshana, विशोधितजटः removed the matted hair, स्नातः had bath, चित्रमाल्यानुलेपनः adorned with colourful garlands and daubed with sandal paste, महार्हवसनोपेतः clothed in exquisite robes, तत्र then, श्रिया shining, ज्वलन् glowing, तस्थौ stood

40019718.author: Translation
40019718.content: Bharata had his bath first, and mighty Lakshmana, Sugriva the monkey king, and Vibheeshana the Rakshasa king followed him. Sri Rama removed the matted hair, had bath, adorned with colourful garlands, and daubed with sandal paste and clothed in exquisite robes stood glowing and shining.

40019719.author: पदार्थः
40019719.content: वीर्यवान् valiant, लक्ष्मीवान् prosperous, इक्ष्वाकुकुलवर्धनः enhancer of the glory of Ikshvaku race, रामस्य Rama's, लक्ष्मणस्य च and Lakshmana's, प्रतिकर्म decorated, कारयामास did

40019719.author: Translation
40019719.content: Then valiant and prosperous, Shatrughna, who is an enhancer of the glory of Ikshvaku race decorated Sri Rama and Lakshmana (duly with ornaments).

40019720.author: पदार्थः
40019720.content: तदा then, सर्वाः all, मनस्विन्यः nobleminded, दशरथस्त्रियः Dasharatha's wives, सीतायाः for Sita, मनोहरम् beautiful, प्रतिकर्म decoration, आत्मनैव themselves, चक्रुः did

40019720.author: Translation
40019720.content: Then all the nobleminded Dasharatha's wives themselves decorated Sita beautifully.

40019721.author: पदार्थः
40019721.content: ततः then, प्रहृष्टाः very delighted, पुत्रवत्सला lover of her sons, कौसल्या Kausalya, सर्वासाम् all, वानरपत्नीनाम् for the wives of Vanaras, यत्नात् took effort, शोभनम् in splendid manner to decorate, चकार started

40019721.author: Translation
40019721.content: The very delighted Kausalya, lover of her sons started making effort to decorate the wives of all Vanaras in a splendid manner.

40019722.author: पदार्थः
40019722.content: ततः then, सुमन्त्रोनाम named Sumantra, सारथिःcharioteer, शत्रुघ्नवचनात् by the command of Shatrughna, सर्वाङ्गशोभनम् all parts of the body, रथम् chariot, योजयित्वा yoked, अभिचक्राम came there

40019722.author: Translation
40019722.content: Then Sumantra the charioteer, commanded by Shatrughna came there with all parts of the chariot decorated and yoked.

40019723.author: पदार्थः
40019723.content: अर्कमण्डलसङ्काशम् like the radiance of the planet sun, स्थितम् stood, दिव्यम् wonderful, रथम् chariot, दृष्टवा seeing, महाबाहुः mighty armed, परपुरंञ्जयः the conqueror of hostile enemies, रामः Rama, आरुरोह ascended

40019723.author: Translation
40019723.content: Seeing the wonderful chariot like the radiance of the planet sun, mighty armed Rama the conqueror of hostile enemies ascended.

40019724.author: पदार्थः
40019724.content: महेन्द्रसदृशद्युती vied with Mahendra in splendour, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, हनुमांश्चैव even Hanuman, स्नातौ having bathed, शुभकुण्डलौ wearing sparkling earrings, दिव्यनिभैः heavenly, वस्त्रः clothes, जग्मतुः started

40019724.author: Translation
40019724.content: Sugriva and Hanuman having bathed wore sparkling earrings, clothed in heavenly robes vied with Mahendra in splendour, started.

40019725.author: पदार्थः
40019725.content: ताः they, सुग्रीवपत्नयाः Sugriva's wife, सीता च and Sita, सर्वाभरणजुष्टाः wearing all kinds of ornaments, शुभकुण्डलाः auspicious earrings, नगरम् city, द्रष्टुम् to see, उत्सुकाः enthused, ययुः departed

40019725.author: Translation
40019725.content: Sugriva's wife and Sita decked with all kinds of ornaments and earrings, enthused to see the city, started.

40019726.author: पदार्थः
40019726.content: अयोध्यायातु at Ayodhya also राज्ञः king, दशरथस्य Dasharatha's, सचिवाः ministers, पुरोहितम् priests, पुरस्कृत्य started, अर्थवत् to Vasishta, मन्त्रयामासुः thought of the required arrangements

40019726.author: Translation
40019726.content: At Ayodhya also, king Dasharatha's ministers, priests started to Vasishta and thought of the required arrangements.

40019727.author: पदार्थः
40019727.content: अशोकः Ashoka, विजयश्चैव Vijaya, सिद्धार्थश्च Siddhartha, समाहिताः collected, रामवृद्ध्यर्थम् for the growth of Rama, नगरस्य and city, बुदद्यर्थम् consulting, मन्त्रयन् thought of

40019727.author: Translation
40019727.content: Ashoka, Vijaya, Siddhartha, collected together and started consulting with each other for the growth of Rama and the City.

40019728.author: पदार्थः
40019728.content: जयार्हस्य for the success, महात्मनः of great soul, रामस्य Rama's, अभिषेकार्थम् for the consecration, यद्यत् Whatever, सर्वम् all, मङ्गलपूर्वकम् auspicious, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हथ who deserves

40019728.author: Translation
40019728.content: For the success of the great soul Rama's consecration, whatever was auspicious, all that ought to be done as he deserves.

40019729.author: पदार्थः
40019729.content: ते they, सर्वे all, मत्रनिणःministers, पुरोहितम् priests, इति thus, सन्दिश्य communicating, रामदर्शनबुद्धयः for having a glance of Rama, तूर्णम् speedily, नगरात् from the city, निर्ययुः set forth

40019729.author: Translation
40019729.content: All those ministers, priests thus communicating with each other, speedily set forth to have a glance at Sri Rama.

40019730.author: पदार्थः
40019730.content: सहस्राक्षः thousand eyed, इन्द्रः Indra, हरियुक्तम् green horses, रथमिव chariot like, अनघः sinless, रामः Rama, उत्तमम् excellent, रथम् chariot, आस्थाय seated, नगरम् to the city, प्रययौ departed

40019730.author: Translation
40019730.content: Like the thousand eyed Indra seated in the excellent chariot yoked to green horses, the sinless Rama departed to the city.

40019731.author: पदार्थः
40019731.content: भरतः Bharata, रमशीन् reins, जग्राह took hold, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, छत्रम् parasol, तस्य his, मूर्ध्नि in front, आददे took, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, व्यजनम् fan, सम्पर्यवीजयत् for fanning, परितः held, स्थितः stood, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa king, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, चन्द्रसङ्काशम् like the moon, श्वेतम् white, अपरम् whisk, वालव्यजनम् for driving the air, जगृहे took hold

40019731.author: Translation
40019731.content: Bharata held the reins, Shatrughna took hold of the parasol, Lakshmana standing in front held the fan, and the Rakshasa king Vibheeshana held a white whisk which was like a moon for driving the air.

40019732.author: पदार्थः
40019732.content: भरतः Bharata, रमशीन् reins, जग्राह took hold, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, छत्रम् parasol, तस्य his, मूर्ध्नि in front, आददे took, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, व्यजनम् fan, सम्पर्यवीजयत् for fanning, परितः held, स्थितः stood, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa king, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, चन्द्रसङ्काशम् like the moon, श्वेतम् white, अपरम् whisk, वालव्यजनम् for driving the air, जगृहे took hold

40019732.author: Translation
40019732.content: Bharata held the reins, Shatrughna took hold of the parasol, Lakshmana standing in front held the fan, and the Rakshasa king Vibheeshana held a white whisk which was like a moon for driving the air.

40019733.author: पदार्थः
40019733.content: तदा then, रामस्य Rama's, ऋषिसङ्घैः host of sages, समरुद्गणैः Rudras, देवैश्च gods, आकाशे in the sky, स्तूयमानस्य started praising, मधुरध्वनिः sweet sounding, शुश्रुवे heard.

40019733.author: Translation
40019733.content: Then the host of sages, Rudras and gods from the heaven started praising Rama with sweet sounding chanting.

40019734.author: पदार्थः
40019734.content: ततः then, प्लवगर्षभः bull among monkeys, महातेजाः resplendent, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, शत्रुञ्जयंनाम Satrumjaya by name, पर्वतोपमम् like a mountain, कुञ्जरम् elephant, आरुरोह ascended

40019734.author: Translation
40019734.content: Then resplendent Sugriva, the bull among Vanaras, ascended the mountain like elephant by the name Satrumjaya.

40019735.author: पदार्थः
40019735.content: वानराः Vanara, मानुषम् human, विग्रहम् semblance, कृत्वा assuming, सर्वाभरणभूषिताः adorned with ornaments, नवनागसहस्राणि nine thousand elephants, आस्थाय ascended, ययुः departed

40019735.author: Translation
40019735.content: Assuming human semblance, the Vanaras adorned with ornaments ascended nine thousand elephants and departed.

40019736.author: पदार्थः
40019736.content: पुरुषव्याघ्रः tiger among men, शङ्खशब्दप्रणादैश्च sound of blasts of conches and shouts, दुन्दुभीनाम् roll of drums, निःस्वनैः च making noise, हर्म्यमालिनीम् rows of mansions, तांपुरीम् that city, प्रययौ went

40019736.author: Translation
40019736.content: Sri Rama the tiger among men went accompanied by sounds of blasts of conches and shouts and roll of drums along the rows of mansions in the city.

40019737.author: पदार्थः
40019737.content: तदा then, ते they, सपुरःसरम् having gone to Ayodhya, वपुषा god, विराजमानम् shining brightly, रथेन by chariot, समायान्तम् coming with all in accordance with tradition, अतिरथम् great car warrior, राघवम् Raghava, ददृशुः saw

40019737.author: Translation
40019737.content: Then they saw all those who had gone to Ayodhya coming in advance in accordance with tradition, to receive Rama, the great car warrior, who was shining brightly advancing by the chariot.

40019738.author: पदार्थः
40019738.content: ते they, काकुत्स्थम् Kakuthsa, वर्धयित्वाblessing, रामेण Rama, प्रतिनन्दिताः in turn very happily responded, भ्रातृभिः brothers also, परिवारितम् surrounded, महात्मानम् great, अनुजग्मुःfollowed

40019738.author: Translation
40019738.content: They were blessing Sri Rama in turn and Rama responded to them very happily. Surrounded by brothers and all followed Rama the great soul.

40019739.author: पदार्थः
40019739.content: अमात्यैः ministers, ब्राह्मणैश्चैव brahmins, तथा so also, प्रकृतिभिः common people, वृतः surrounded, रामः Rama, नक्षत्रैः star, चन्द्रमाःइव like moon, श्रिया glorious, विरुरुचे shone brightly.

40019739.author: Translation
40019739.content: Surrounded by ministers, brahmins and common people, glorious Rama shone brightly like the moon surrounded by stars.

40019740.author: पदार्थः
40019740.content: सः he, पुरोगामिभिः went forward, तूर्यैः bands, तालस्वस्तिकपाणिभिः with trumpets, wooden cymbals and swastikas, मङ्गलानि auspicious, प्रव्याहरद्भिः singing festive songs, मुदितैः very happily, वृतः covered, ययौ went

40019740.author: Translation
40019740.content: He went forward surrounded by bands, trumpets, wooden cymbals and swastikas and very happily singing auspicious festive songs.

40019741.author: पदार्थः
40019741.content: अक्षतम् yellow rice जातरूपं च appearing like gold, गावः cows, कन्याः virgin women, सहद्विजाः with brahmins, मोदकहस्ताः with Modakas in hand, नराः men, रामस्य Rama's, पुरतः before, ययुः went

40019741.author: Translation
40019741.content: Taking yellow rice (rice smeared with turmeric) appearing like gold, cows, virgin women, brahmins with Modakas in hand went before Rama.

40019742.author: पदार्थः
40019742.content: अथ and then, रामः Rama, सुग्रीवे Sugriva, सख्यं च friendship, अनिलात्मजे of the son of wind god, प्रभावं च distinct performance, वानराणाम् Vanaras, तत् that, कर्म च actions, मन्त्रिणाम् to ministers, आचचक्षे narrated

40019742.author: Translation
40019742.content: Rama narrated about his friendship with Sugriva and the distinct performance of Hanuman and Vanaras to the ministers.

40019743.author: पदार्थः
40019743.content: अयोध्यापुरवासिनः citizens of Ayodhya, वानराणाम् Vanaras, तत् that, कर्म action, राक्षसानाम् of Rakshasas, तत् their, बलं च strength, श्रुत्वा hearing, विस्मयम् astonished, जग्मुः became

40019743.author: Translation
40019743.content: Hearing about the action of Vanaras and the strength of Rakshasas, the citizens of Ayodhya were astonished.

40019744.author: पदार्थः
40019744.content: अथ and then, मन्त्रिणाम् ministers, विभीषणस्य Vibheeshana, संयोगम् friendship, आचचक्षे narrated, द्युतिमान् splendorous, सः he, रामःRama, एतत् all that, आख्याय told, वानरसंयुतः accompanied by Vanaras, हृष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णाम् very happy filled with people, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, प्रविवेश entered

40019744.author: Translation
40019744.content: Sri Rama narrated about Vibheeshana's friendship to the ministers. Splendorous Rama then entered Ayodhya filled with very happy people accompanied by Vanaras.

40019745.author: पदार्थः
40019745.content: ततः thereupon, पौराः citizens, गृहेगृहे every house, पताकाः flag, अभ्युच्छ्रयन् lifted up and held, ऐक्ष्वाकाध्युषितम् abode of Ikshvaku dynasty, पितुः father, रम्यम् beautiful, गृहम् home, आससाद reached.

40019745.author: Translation
40019745.content: The citizens of Ayodhya held the flags up in every house. Thereupon Rama reached the beautiful home of his father, the abode of the Ikshvaku dynasty.

40019746.author: पदार्थः
40019746.content: अथ and then, राजपुत्रः prince, रघुनन्दनः the joy of Raghus, महात्मनः great soul, पितुः father, भवनम् mansion, आसाद्य reached, कौसल्यां च and Kausalya's, सुमित्रां च and Sumitra's, कैकेयीं च and Kaikeyi's, अभिवाद्य च greeted them, धर्मिणाम् virtuous, परम् supreme, भरतम् Bharata, अर्थोपहितया meaningful, वाचा words, मधुरम् sweet tone, अब्रवीत् spoke

40019746.author: Translation
40019746.content: And thereafter prince Rama, the joy of Raghus, the great soul reached father's mansion and then to Kausalya's and to Sumitra, to Kaikeyi and greeted them. He then spoke meaningful words to virtuous Bharata in a sweet tone.

40019747.author: पदार्थः
40019747.content: अथ and then, राजपुत्रः prince, रघुनन्दनः the joy of Raghus, महात्मनः great soul, पितुः father, भवनम् mansion, आसाद्य reached, कौसल्यां च and Kausalya's, सुमित्रां च and Sumitra's, कैकेयीं च and Kaikeyi's, अभिवाद्य च greeted them, धर्मिणाम् virtuous, परम् supreme, भरतम् Bharata, अर्थोपहितया meaningful, वाचा words, मधुरम् sweet tone, अब्रवीत् spoke

40019747.author: Translation
40019747.content: And thereafter prince Rama, the joy of Raghus, the great soul reached father's mansion and then to Kausalya's and to Sumitra, to Kaikeyi and greeted them. He then spoke meaningful words to virtuous Bharata in a sweet tone.

40019748.author: पदार्थः
40019748.content: श्रेष्टं splendid, साशोकवनिकम् palace with Ashoka grove, मुक्तावैदूर्यसङ्कीर्णम् encrusted with pearls cat's eye gems, महत् excellent, तत् that, मद्भवनम् that mansion, सुग्रीवाय to Sugriva, निवेदय be place at his disposal

40019748.author: Translation
40019748.content: Let the splendid, excellent mansion attached to Ashoka grove, encrusted with cat's eye gems and pearls be placed at the disposal of Sugriva.

40019749.author: पदार्थः
40019749.content: ततः then, सत्यविक्रमःupright, भरतःBharata, तस्य his, तत् वचनम् that words, श्रुत्वा hearing, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, हस्ते hand, गृहीत्वा taking, तम् to him आलयम् that temple like abode, प्रविवेश entered

40019749.author: Translation
40019749.content: Then that upright Bharata hearing the words of Rama taking the hand of Sugriva led him to that temple like abode.

40019750.author: पदार्थः
40019750.content: ततः then, शत्रुघ्नेन by Shatrughna, प्रचोदिताः commanded, तैलप्रदीप्तांश्च glowing oil lamps, पर्यङ्कास्तरणानि च coverlets for the couches, गृहीत्वा taking, क्षिप्रम् quickly, विविशुःentered

40019750.author: Translation
40019750.content: Then as commanded by Shatrughna, people taking glowing oil lamps and coverlets for the couches quickly entered the palace.

40019751.author: पदार्थः
40019751.content: महातेजाः highly brilliant, राघवानुजःRaghava's brother, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, उवाच च spoke, प्रभोking, रामस्य Rama's, अभिषेकाय for the consecration, दूतान्envoys, आज्ञापयmay be ordered

40019751.author: Translation
40019751.content: Highly brilliant Sugriva said to Bharata, "Let envoys be sent for the consecration of Rama."

40019752.author: पदार्थः
40019752.content: स: he, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, क्षिप्रम् instantly, चतुर्णाम् four, वानरेन्द्राणाम् Vanara leaders, सौवर्णान् golden, सर्वरत्नविभूषितान् well decorated, चतुरः four, घटान् pots, ददौ gave

40019752.author: Translation
40019752.content: Sugriva instantly gave four golden pots decorated well to the four Vanara leaders.

40019753.author: पदार्थः
40019753.content: वानराः Vanaras, चतुर्याम् four of them, सागराम्बसाम् waters from the ocean, पूर्णैःfilled, घटैःpots, प्रत्यूषसमये early morning time, यथा so, प्रतीक्षध्वम् wait for me, तथाकुरुतyou do

40019753.author: Translation
40019753.content: Sugriva gave four pots to the four of the Vanaras to get them filled with the water of the four oceans and get them by early morning and said to await for him.

40019754.author: पदार्थः
40019754.content: एवम् in that way, उक्ताःspoken, वारणोपमाः like mountain in form, गरुडाःइव like Garuda, शीघ्रगाःsped, महात्मानःgreat souls, वानराः Vanaras, शीघ्रम् quickly, गगनम् into the sky, उत्पेतुःrose up

40019754.author: Translation
40019754.content: Having spoken like that by Sugriva, the Vanaras of mountainlike forms fled like Garuda into the sky quickly.

40019755.author: पदार्थः
40019755.content: जाम्बवांश्च Jambavantha, हनूमांश्च Hanuman, वेगदर्शी Vegadarsa, वानरः Vanara, ऋषभश्चैव Rshaba, कलशा pots, न्जलपूर्णा filled with sea water, नथानयन् different rivers, नदीशतानां a hundred rivers, पञ्चानां five, जलंwater, कुम्भैरुपाहरन् brought in pots, अथ and then, सत्त्वसम्पन्नः richly endowed with courage, सुषेणः Sushena, पूर्वात् eastern समुद्रात् ocean, सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् decorated with all kinds of gems, जलपूर्णम् pot filled with water, कलशम् pot, आनयत् brought

40019755.author: Translation
40019755.content: Jambavan, Hanuman, Vegadarsa and Rshaba brought pots of water from the seas. Another five hundred monkeys brought five hundred pots from five hundred rivers of the country. Jambavan richly endowed with courage brought in a pot encrusted with all kinds of gems. Sushena brought water from the eastern sea.

40019756.author: पदार्थः
40019756.content: जाम्बवांश्च Jambavantha, हनूमांश्च Hanuman, वेगदर्शी Vegadarsa, वानरः Vanara, ऋषभश्चैव Rshaba, कलशा pots, न्जलपूर्णा filled with sea water, नथानयन् different rivers, नदीशतानां a hundred rivers, पञ्चानां five, जलंwater, कुम्भैरुपाहरन् brought in pots, अथ and then, सत्त्वसम्पन्नः richly endowed with courage, सुषेणः Sushena, पूर्वात् eastern समुद्रात् ocean, सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् decorated with all kinds of gems, जलपूर्णम् pot filled with water, कलशम् pot, आनयत् brought

40019756.author: Translation
40019756.content: Jambavan, Hanuman, Vegadarsa and Rshaba brought pots of water from the seas. Another five hundred monkeys brought five hundred pots from five hundred rivers of the country. Jambavan richly endowed with courage brought in a pot encrusted with all kinds of gems. Sushena brought water from the eastern sea.

40019757.author: पदार्थः
40019757.content: जाम्बवांश्च Jambavantha, हनूमांश्च Hanuman, वेगदर्शी Vegadarsa, वानरः Vanara, ऋषभश्चैव Rshaba, कलशा pots, न्जलपूर्णा filled with sea water, नथानयन् different rivers, नदीशतानां a hundred rivers, पञ्चानां five, जलंwater, कुम्भैरुपाहरन् brought in pots, अथ and then, सत्त्वसम्पन्नः richly endowed with courage, सुषेणः Sushena, पूर्वात् eastern समुद्रात् ocean, सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् decorated with all kinds of gems, जलपूर्णम् pot filled with water, कलशम् pot, आनयत् brought

40019757.author: Translation
40019757.content: Jambavan, Hanuman, Vegadarsa and Rshaba brought pots of water from the seas. Another five hundred monkeys brought five hundred pots from five hundred rivers of the country. Jambavan richly endowed with courage brought in a pot encrusted with all kinds of gems. Sushena brought water from the eastern sea.

40019758.author: पदार्थः
40019758.content: ऋषभः Rshaba, दक्षिणात् समुद्रात् from southern sea, रक्तचन्दनशाखाभिः covered with red sandal paste, संवृतम् covered, काञ्चनम् golden, घटम् pot, जलम् water, तूर्णम् quickly, आनयत् brought

40019758.author: Translation
40019758.content: Rshaba quickly brought water from the southern sea in a golden pot covered with sandal paste.

40019759.author: पदार्थः
40019759.content: मारुतविक्रमःexpert like wind god, गवयः Gavaya, महता great, रत्नकुम्भेन pot encrusted with gems, पश्चिमात् west sea, महार्णवात् great abode of varuna, शीतम् cold, तोयम् water, आजहार brought

40019759.author: Translation
40019759.content: Gavaya, an expert like WindGod brought cold water from the abode of Varuna in the west, in a pot encrusted with gems.

40019760.author: पदार्थः
40019760.content: गरुडानिलविक्रमःwho vied with Garuda in speed, धर्मात्मा righteous, सर्वगुणान्वितः endowed with all virtues, सः he, नलः Nala, उत्तरात् north, शीघ्रम् quickly, जलम् water, आजहार brought

40019760.author: Translation
40019760.content: Nala who vied with Garuda in speed, a righteous one, endowed with all virtues quickly brought water from the north.

40019761.author: पदार्थः
40019761.content: ततः then, सचिवैःसह along with ministers, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, रामस्य Rama's, अभिषेकाय for the consecration, तैः they, वानरश्रेष्ठैः foremost of Vanaras, आनीतम् brought by, तत् that, जलम् water, श्रेष्ठाय supreme, पुरोहिताय priest, सुहृद्भ्यः च friends, न्यवेदयत् placed

40019761.author: Translation
40019761.content: Then seeing the water brought by the monkeys for Rama's consecration Shatrugna along with ministers placed them at the disposal of the supreme priest along with friends.

40019762.author: पदार्थः
40019762.content: ततः then, ब्राह्मणैःसह with brahmins, वृद्धःaged, वसिष्ठः Vasishta, प्रयतः active, ससीतम् Sita, रामम्Rama, रत्नमये full of precious stones, पीठे plank, सन्नयवेशयत् to take seat.

40019762.author: Translation
40019762.content: Then accompanied by brahmins, sage Vasishta, active though aged, asked Sita and Sri Rama to occupy the plank made with full of precious stones.

40019763.author: पदार्थः
40019763.content: वसिष्ठः Vasishta, वामदेवश्चजाबालिः VamaDeva, Jabali अथ and, काश्यपः Kasyapa, कात्यायनः Katyayana, सुयज्ञः Suyajna, गौतमः Gautam, तथा so also, विजयः Vijaya, प्रसन्नेन pure, सुगन्धिभा fragrant, सलिलेन waters, वसवः Indra, सहस्राक्षम् thousand eyed, वासवंयथा like Vasus, नरव्याघ्रम् tiger among men, अभ्यषिञ्चन् consecrated

40019763.author: Translation
40019763.content: Eight sages, Vasishta, Vama Deva, Jabali, Kasyapa, Katyayana, Suyajna, Gautama and Vijaya consecrated Sri Rama, the tiger among men, with pure fragrant waters as the Vasus consecrated the thousand eyed Indra.

40019764.author: पदार्थः
40019764.content: वसिष्ठः Vasishta, वामदेवश्चजाबालिः VamaDeva, Jabali अथ and, काश्यपः Kasyapa, कात्यायनः Katyayana, सुयज्ञः Suyajna, गौतमः Gautam, तथा so also, विजयः Vijaya, प्रसन्नेन pure, सुगन्धिभा fragrant, सलिलेन waters, वसवः Indra, सहस्राक्षम् thousand eyed, वासवंयथा like Vasus, नरव्याघ्रम् tiger among men, अभ्यषिञ्चन् consecrated

40019764.author: Translation
40019764.content: Eight sages, Vasishta, Vama Deva, Jabali, Kasyapa, Katyayana, Suyajna, Gautama and Vijaya consecrated Sri Rama, the tiger among men, with pure fragrant waters as the Vasus consecrated the thousand eyed Indra.

40019765.author: पदार्थः
40019765.content: सम्प्रहृष्टाः very delighted, ते they, पूर्वम् first, ऋत्विग्भि: priests, ब्राह्मणैः brahmins, कन्याभिः virgin women, तथा so also, मन्त्रिभिः ministers, सनैगमैः merchants,, योथौश्च warriors, नभसि in the sky, स्थितैः stood, देवैः gods, चतुर्भिः four, लोकपालैश्च rulers of quarters, सङ्गतैः assembled, सर्वैः all, देवैश्च gods, सर्वौषथरसाश्चैपि all kinds of medicinal herbs, अभ्यषिञ्चन् consecration

40019765.author: Translation
40019765.content: First by priests, followed by brahmins, virgin women, so also ministers, merchants, warriors consecrated. Those who stood in the sky, the gods, the rulers of the four quarters, and all gods consecrated by sprinkling water containing medicinal herbs. All were very delighted.

40019766.author: पदार्थः
40019766.content: सम्प्रहृष्टाः very delighted, ते they, पूर्वम् first, ऋत्विग्भि: priests, ब्राह्मणैः brahmins, कन्याभिः virgin women, तथा so also, मन्त्रिभिः ministers, सनैगमैः merchants,, योथौश्च warriors, नभसि in the sky, स्थितैः stood, देवैः gods, चतुर्भिः four, लोकपालैश्च rulers of quarters, सङ्गतैः assembled, सर्वैः all, देवैश्च gods, सर्वौषथरसाश्चैपि all kinds of medicinal herbs, अभ्यषिञ्चन् consecration

40019766.author: Translation
40019766.content: First by priests, followed by brahmins, virgin women, so also ministers, merchants, warriors consecrated. Those who stood in the sky, the gods, the rulers of the four quarters, and all gods consecrated by sprinkling water containing medicinal herbs. All were very delighted.

40019767.author: पदार्थः
40019767.content: येन by whom, पुरा in the past, मनुः Manu, अभिषिक्तः consecrated, तस्य his, अन्ववाये followed, राजानः kings, येन whom, अभिषेचिताः consecration, तम् him, पूर्वम् earlier, ब्रह्मणा Brahma, निर्मितम् constructed, रत्नशोभितम् encrusted with gems, दीप्ततेजसम् dazzling, किरीटम् crown, हेमक्लुप्तायाम् made of gold, महाधनैः riches, शोभियाताम् splendid, नानाविधैः several kinds, सुशोभनैः charming, रत्नैः gems, चित्रितायाम् with wonderful pictures, सभायाम् council hall, नानारत्नमये with different gems, पीठे throne, यथाविधि as per tradition, कल्पयित्वा arranged, ततः then पश्चात् seeing that, महात्मना great soul, वसिष्ठेन by Vasishta, किरीटेन crown, ऋ त्विगिमभगिः priests also, भूषणैश्चैव ornaments also, राघवः Raghava,

40019767.author: Translation
40019767.content: In the past, Manu was consecrated with a crown encrusted with gems crafted by Brahma and it was adorned at consecration by successive kings. After the consecration, Rama was dazzling seated on a throne made of several kinds of gems as per tradition. The council hall was also made of gold with charming pictures and looked splendid. The great soul Raghava was crowned and adorned with ornaments by Vasishta and the priests.

40019768.author: पदार्थः
40019768.content: येन by whom, पुरा in the past, मनुः Manu, अभिषिक्तः consecrated, तस्य his, अन्ववाये followed, राजानः kings, येन whom, अभिषेचिताः consecration, तम् him, पूर्वम् earlier, ब्रह्मणा Brahma, निर्मितम् constructed, रत्नशोभितम् encrusted with gems, दीप्ततेजसम् dazzling, किरीटम् crown, हेमक्लुप्तायाम् made of gold, महाधनैः riches, शोभियाताम् splendid, नानाविधैः several kinds, सुशोभनैः charming, रत्नैः gems, चित्रितायाम् with wonderful pictures, सभायाम् council hall, नानारत्नमये with different gems, पीठे throne, यथाविधि as per tradition, कल्पयित्वा arranged, ततः then पश्चात् seeing that, महात्मना great soul, वसिष्ठेन by Vasishta, किरीटेन crown, ऋ त्विगिमभगिः priests also, भूषणैश्चैव ornaments also, राघवः Raghava,

40019768.content: In the past, Manu was consecrated with a crown encrusted with gems crafted by Brahma and it was adorned at consecration by successive kings. After the consecration, Rama was dazzling seated on a throne made of several kinds of gems as per tradition. The council hall was also made of gold with charming pictures and looked splendid. The great soul Raghava was crowned and adorned with ornaments by Vasishta and the priests.

40019771.author: पदार्थः
40019771.content: शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, तस्य his, पाण्डुरम् white, शुभम् auspicious, छत्रम् parasol, जग्राह held, वानरेश्वरः Vanara Lord, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, श्वेतम् white, वालव्यजनम् whisk, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa king, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, चन्द्रसङ्काशम् shining like moon, अपरंच white whisk

40019771.author: Translation
40019771.content: Shatrughna held white auspicious parasol, Sugriva the Vanara Lord held a white whisk, Vibheeshana the Lord of Rakshasas held a white whisk shining like the moon.

40019772.author: पदार्थः
40019772.content: शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, तस्य his, पाण्डुरम् white, शुभम् auspicious, छत्रम् parasol, जग्राह held, वानरेश्वरः Vanara Lord, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, श्वेतम् white, वालव्यजनम् whisk, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa king, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, चन्द्रसङ्काशम् shining like moon, अपरंच white whisk

40019772.author: Translation
40019772.content: Shatrughna held white auspicious parasol, Sugriva the Vanara Lord held a white whisk, Vibheeshana the Lord of Rakshasas held a white whisk shining like the moon.

40019773.author: पदार्थः
40019773.content: वायुः wind god, वासवेन by Indra, प्रचोदितः prompted, वपुषा deity, ज्वलन्तीम् dazzling, मालां garland, शतपुष्कराम् of a hundred flowers, काञ्चनीम् gold राघवाय to Raghava, ददौ gave

40019773.author: Translation
40019773.content: The WindGod prompted by deity Indra presented a dazzling golden garland of hundred flowers to Raghava.

40019774.author: पदार्थः
40019774.content: शक्रप्रचोदितः urged by Indra, सर्वरत्नसमायुत्तम् intercepted by several kinds of gems, मणिभिश्च precious stones, विभूषितम् dazzling, मुक्ताहारम् of pearls, नरेन्द्राय to the ruler of the world, ददौ gave

40019774.author: Translation
40019774.content: Urged by Indra the wind god gave a dazzling pearls chain intercepted by several kinds of gems and precious stones to the ruler of the world.

40019775.author: पदार्थः
40019775.content: तदा then, तदर्हस्य, रामस्य Rama's, अभिषेके consecration, देवगन्धर्वाः gods and Gandharvas, प्रजगुः sang, अप्सरोगणाः Apsara groups ननृतुः danced

40019775.author: Translation
40019775.content: The Gandharvas from among the gods sang and Apsara groups danced for Rama's consecration.

40019776.author: पदार्थः
40019776.content: राघवोत्सवे at the celebration of Rama, भूमिः earth, सस्यवती as green with crops, पादपाः trees, फलवन्तश्च filled with fruits, पुष्पाणि flowers, गन्धवन्ति च spread fragrance, बभूवुः became

40019776.author: Translation
40019776.content: At the time of celebration of Rama's coronation, earth became green with crops, trees bore fruits and filled with flowers which spread fragrance.

40019777.author: पदार्थः
40019777.content: मनुजर्षभः bull among men, पूर्वम् first, अश्वानाम् horses, सहस्रशतम् hundred thousand, तथा so also, धेनूनाम् calves, गवां च cows that just delivered, शतवृषान् hundred thousand, द्विजेभ्यः brahmins, ददौ gave

40019777.author: Translation
40019777.content: Sri Rama, the bull among men gave first, a hundred thousand cows with just born calves to hundred thousand brahmins.

40019778.author: पदार्थः
40019778.content: राघवः Raghava, पुनः again, ब्राह्मणेभ्यः brahmins, हिरण्यस्य golden, त्रिशत्कोटीः thirty crores, महार्हाणि excellent, नानाभरणवस्त्राणि different kinds of ornaments and clothes, ददौ gave

40019778.author: Translation
40019778.content: Raghava again gave brahmins thirty crores of golden coins and different kinds of ornaments and clothes.

40019779.author: पदार्थः
40019779.content: मनुजाधिपः Lord of the people, सुग्रीवाय Sugriva, अर्करश्मिप्रतीकाशाम् dazzling like sun's rays, मणिविग्रहाम् stretch of gems, काञ्चनीम् golden, दिव्याम् wonderful, स्रजम् tied, सुग्रीवाय to Sugriva, प्रायच्छत् presented

40019779.author: Translation
40019779.content: Sri Rama gave a wonderful golden garland with a stretch of gems tied to it which was dazzling like the sun's rays to Sugriva.

40019780.author: पदार्थः
40019780.content: धृतिमान् very lovingly, वैदूर्यमयचित्रे च wonderful with cat's eyes stones, मणिरत्नविभूषिते fixed with gems and precious gems, अङ्गदे to Angada, वालिपुत्राय son of Vali, अङ्गदाय to Angada, ददौ gave

40019780.author: Translation
40019780.content: Very lovingly Rama gave Angada the son of Vali, wonderful armlets encrusted with cat's eye stones and precious gems.

40019781.author: पदार्थः
40019781.content: रामः Rama, मणिप्रवरजुष्टम् encrusted with gems and corals, अनुत्तमम् best, तम् them, चन्द्ररश्मि moon beams समप्रभम् unsurpassed, मुक्ताहारम् pearl chain, अरजे immaculate, दिव्ये wonderful, वाससी clothes, शुभानि splendid, आभरणानि च ornaments, सीतायै to Sita, प्रददौ presented अवेक्षमाणा looking at, वैदेही Vaidehi, प्रददौ gave, वायुसूनवे Hanuman

40019781.author: Translation
40019781.content: Rama gave Sita an unsurpassed pearl chain (given to him by the wind god) encrusted with the best of gems and corals wonderfully shining like moonbeams. And Sita looking at Rama presented that immaculate wonderful pearl chain, and splendid clothes with some ornaments to Hanuman.

40019782.author: पदार्थः
40019782.content: रामः Rama, मणिप्रवरजुष्टम् encrusted with gems and corals, अनुत्तमम् best, तम् them, चन्द्ररश्मि moon beams समप्रभम् unsurpassed, मुक्ताहारम् pearl chain, अरजे immaculate, दिव्ये wonderful, वाससी clothes, शुभानि splendid, आभरणानि च ornaments, सीतायै to Sita, प्रददौ presented अवेक्षमाणा looking at, वैदेही Vaidehi, प्रददौ gave, वायुसूनवे Hanuman

40019783.author: पदार्थः
40019783.content: जनकनन्दिनी enhancer of Janaka's joy, आत्मनः own, कण्ठात् from her neck, हारम् that chain, अवमुच्य to give away, सर्वान् all, हरीन् monkeys, भर्तारं च husband also, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, अवैक्षत looking

40019783.author: Translation
40019783.content: Removing the pearl chain from her neck, Janaki looked at all the monkeys as well as her husband again and again.

40019784.author: पदार्थः
40019784.content: इङ्गितज्ञः one who could read the mind, ताम् her, सम्प्रेक्ष्य seeing, ताम् her, जनकात्मजाम् Janaki, बभाषे said, सुभगे lovely, भामिनि beautiful young lady, यस्य his, तुष्टा pleased, असि to them, यस्मिन् your, तेजः brilliance, दृतिः determination, यशः fame, दाक्ष्यम् dexterity, सामर्थ्यम् capacity, विनयः modesty, नयः prudence, पौरुषम् virility, विक्रमः prowess, बुद्धिः intelligence, एतानि all these, सर्वदा ever, हारम् garland, प्रदेहि gift

40019784.author: Translation
40019784.content: Seeing Janaki looking at him, Rama who could read her mind, and said" Lovely Sita, Beautiful young lady, give the pearl chain to one with whom you are pleased." Sita you may give the chain to one in whom you always found to have brilliance, determination, fame, dexterity, capacity, modesty, prudence, virility, prowess, and intelligence always.

40019785.author: पदार्थः
40019785.content: इङ्गितज्ञः one who could read the mind, ताम् her, सम्प्रेक्ष्य seeing, ताम् her, जनकात्मजाम् Janaki, बभाषे said, सुभगे lovely, भामिनि beautiful young lady, यस्य his, तुष्टा pleased, असि to them, यस्मिन् your, तेजः brilliance, दृतिः determination, यशः fame, दाक्ष्यम् dexterity, सामर्थ्यम् capacity, विनयः modesty, नयः prudence, पौरुषम् virility, विक्रमः prowess, बुद्धिः intelligence, एतानि all these, सर्वदा ever, हारम् garland, प्रदेहि gift

40019786.author: पदार्थः
40019786.content: असितेक्षणा blackeyed, सा she, तंहारम् that chain, वायुपुत्राय to Hanuman ददौ give, वानरर्षभः bull among Vanaras, हनूमान् Hanuman, चन्ध्रांशुचयगौरेण like moonbeams, तेनहारेण to him that monkey, श्वेताभ्रेण silver like cloud, अचलःयथा like mountain, शुशुभे shone

40019786.author: Translation
40019786.content: Blackeyed Sita, gave that chain to Hanuman, the bull among Vanaras who shone like a mountain behind white silver like cloud.

40019787.author: पदार्थः
40019787.content: ततः then, परन्तपः tormentor of enemies, वसुधाधिपः ruler of the earth, वीक्ष्य looking, मैन्दद्विविदाभ्याम् Mainda, Dwivida, नीलाय च Neela also, सर्वान् all, कामगुणान् desires, प्रददौ gaveसर्वे all, वानरवृद्धाश्च aged Vanaras, ये who, अन्ये others, वानरोत्तमाःforemost of Vanaras, यथार्हम् according to What they deserve, वासोभिः garments, भूषणैश्चैव ornaments, प्रतिपूजिताः worshipped in turn

40019787.author: Translation
40019787.content: Then Sri Rama, the tormentor of enemies, the ruler of the earth looking at Mainda, Dwivida and Neela presented articles according to their desires. For the aged among the Vanaras and the foremost Vanaras, he gave ornaments and garments duly as much as they deserved and worshipped.

40019788.author: पदार्थः
40019788.content: ततः then, परन्तपः tormentor of enemies, वसुधाधिपः ruler of the earth, वीक्ष्य looking, मैन्दद्विविदाभ्याम् Mainda, Dwivida, नीलाय च Neela also, सर्वान् all, कामगुणान् desires, प्रददौ gaveसर्वे all, वानरवृद्धाश्च aged Vanaras, ये who, अन्ये others, वानरोत्तमाःforemost of Vanaras, यथार्हम् according to What they deserve, वासोभिः garments, भूषणैश्चैव ornaments, प्रतिपूजिताः worshipped in turn

40019788.author: Translation
40019788.content: Then Sri Rama, the tormentor of enemies, the ruler of the earth looking at Mainda, Dwivida and Neela presented articles according to their desires. For the aged among the Vanaras and the foremost Vanaras, he gave ornaments and garments duly as much as they deserved and worshipped.

40019789.author: पदार्थः
40019789.content: अथ and then, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, हनुमान् Hanuman, तथा so aslo, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, सर्वे all, वानरमुख्याश्च chiefs of Vanaras, सर्वे all, अक्लिष्टकर्मणा unwearied in action, रामेण from Rama, कामैः desired objects, पुष्कलैः abundant, रत्नैः gems, यथार्हम् as they deserved, प्रतिपूजिताः worshipped in return, सर्वे all, प्रहृष्टमानसः very delighted in mind, यथागतम् respective places, जग्मुरेव went

40019789.author: Translation
40019789.content: And thereafter Vibheeshana, Sugriva, Hanuman, Jambavan, all Vanara chiefs of unwearied action having received gifts, abundant gems, and desired objects as they deserved from Rama. They worshipped Rama and very delighted at heart went to their respective places.

40019790.author: पदार्थः
40019790.content: अथ and then, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, हनुमान् Hanuman, तथा so aslo, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, सर्वे all, वानरमुख्याश्च chiefs of Vanaras, सर्वे all, अक्लिष्टकर्मणा unwearied in action, रामेण from Rama, कामैः desired objects, पुष्कलैः abundant, रत्नैः gems, यथार्हम् as they deserved, प्रतिपूजिताः worshipped in return, सर्वे all, प्रहृष्टमानसः very delighted in mind, यथागतम् respective places, जग्मुरेव went

40019790.author: Translation
40019790.content: And thereafter Vibheeshana, Sugriva, Hanuman, Jambavan, all Vanara chiefs of unwearied action having received gifts, abundant gems, and desired objects as they deserved from Rama. They worshipped Rama and very delighted at heart went to their respective places.

40019791.author: पदार्थः
40019791.content: ततः then, महात्मानः great soul, ते those, स्ततस्ते lauded, वानरर्षभाः Vanara bulls, सर्वे all, नत्वा, पार्थिवेन्द्रेण ruler of the earth, विसृष्टाः great celebration, किष्किन्धाम् to Kishkinda, समुपागमन् departed

40019791.author: Translation
40019791.content: All the high souled bulls among Vanaras, lauded by the ruler of the earth departed to Kishkinda after seeing the great celebration.

40019792.author: पदार्थः
40019792.content: वानरश्रेष्ठ foremost of Vanaras, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, रामाभिषेचनम् Rama's coronation, दृष्टवा having seen, रामेण from Rama, पूजितश्चैव having been honoured, किष्किन्धांपुरीम् Kishkinda, प्रविशत् entered

40019792.author: Translation
40019792.content: Sugriva, the foremost of the Vanaras having seen Rama's coronation and been honoured, entered Kishkinda.

40019793.author: पदार्थः
40019793.content: धर्मात्मा righteous, महायशाः of great fame, राजा king, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, कुलधनम् family fortune, लब्ध्वा having received, तैः, नैरृतर्षभैः bull of the Rakshasas, लङ्काम् to Lanka, प्रायात् departed

40019793.author: Translation
40019793.content: Vibheeshana, the bull of Rakshasas, of great fame and a righteous king, having received family fortune departed to Lanka.

40019794.author: पदार्थः
40019794.content: महायशाः of great renown, परमोदारः highly generous, सःराघवः he, Raghava, निहतारिः putting an end to enemies, अखिलम् entire, राज्यम् kingdom, शासन् rule, परया great, मुदा joy, शशास ruling,

40019794.author: Translation
40019794.content: Highly renowned and generous Raghava, putting an end to enemies ruled the entire kingdom with great joy. He said to Lakshmana who was a lover of duty and knower of dharma.

40019795.author: पदार्थः
40019795.content: धर्मज्ञं knower of dharma, धर्मवत्सल: lover of dharma, लक्ष्मणं Lakshmana, रामो Rama, उवाच spoke, धर्मज्ञ knower of dharma, पूर्वराजाध्युषिताम्, prior to consecration इमाम् these, गाम् kingdom, बलेन army, मयासह with me, आतिष्ठ get up, या he who, पितृभिः father, धृता grandfather, ताम् all of them, धुरम् previous kings, त्वम् you, मया with me, तुल्यम् togetherequally, यौवराज्ये prince regent, उद्वहस्व bear the burden

40019795.author: Translation
40019795.content: "Lakshmana! You are a knower of dharma and a lover of dharma. Prior to my consecration, this kingdom was ruled by former kings, fathers, and forefathers also with the help of the army. You bear the burden equally with me by being installed as Prince Regent", said Rama.

40019796.author: पदार्थः
40019796.content: धर्मज्ञं knower of dharma, धर्मवत्सल: lover of dharma, लक्ष्मणं Lakshmana, रामो Rama, उवाच spoke, धर्मज्ञ knower of dharma, पूर्वराजाध्युषिताम्, prior to consecration इमाम् these, गाम् kingdom, बलेन army, मयासह with me, आतिष्ठ get up, या he who, पितृभिः father, धृता grandfather, ताम् all of them, धुरम् previous kings, त्वम् you, मया with me, तुल्यम् togetherequally, यौवराज्ये prince regent, उद्वहस्व bear the burden

40019796.author: Translation
40019796.content: "Lakshmana! You are a knower of dharma and a lover of dharma. Prior to my consecration, this kingdom was ruled by former kings, fathers, and forefathers also with the help of the army. You bear the burden equally with me by being installed as Prince Regent", said Rama.

40019797.author: पदार्थः
40019797.content: यौवराज्ये Prince Regent, नियुज्यमानः compelling, अपि also, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, पर्यनुनीयमानः repeatedly, यदा that, सर्वात्मना high souled, योगम् the position of Regent, नोपैति not accepted, ततः then, महात्मा great soul, भरतम् Bharata, अभ्यषिञ्चत् consecrated

40019797.author: Translation
40019797.content: When Saumithri was compelled repeatedly to accept the position of Prince Regent by the high soul great Rama, he had not accepted. Rama consecrated Bharata as Prince Regent.

40019798.author: पदार्थः
40019798.content: पार्धिवात्मजः son of king Dasharatha, पौण्डरीकाश्वमेधाभ्याम् Paundarika, Aswamedha, वाजपेयेन Vajapeya, विविधैः several, अन्यैः other, यज्ञैः yajnas, असकृत् performed, अयजत् several times

40019798.author: Translation
40019798.content: Rama, the son of Dasharatha, had performed many a time Pundarika, Aswamedha, Vajapeya and several other yajnas and propitiated gods.

40019799.author: पदार्थः
40019799.content: राघवः Raghava, दशसहस्राणि ten thousand, वर्षाणि years, राज्यम् kingdom, प्राप्य got, सदश्वान् excellent horses, भूरिदक्षिणान् liberal donations, शताश्वमेधान् hundred horse sacrifices, आजह्रे performed

40019799.author: Translation
40019799.content: Raghava in the ten thousand years of his rule performed hundred horse sacrifices with excellent horses and gave donations liberally.

40019800.author: पदार्थः
40019800.content: आजानुलम्बिबाहुः whose arms reached unto knees, महावक्षाः broadchested, प्रतापवान् stupendous, सः he, रामः Rama, लक्ष्मणानुचरः Lakshmana s his follower, इमाम् in this, पृथिवीम् earth, शशास ruled

40019800.author: Translation
40019800.content: Sri Rama whose arms reached unto knees, endowed with broadchest and stupendous glory, ruled this earth with Lakshmana as his follower.

40019801.author: पदार्थः
40019801.content: धर्मात्मा righteous, राघवश्चापि Rama too, अनुत्तमम् supreme, राज्यम् kingdom, प्राप्य having inherited, ससुतभ्रातृबान्धवः with brothers, friends and relatives, बहुविधैः of several kinds, यज्ञैः sacrifices, ईजे held

40019801.author: Translation
40019801.content: Righteous Rama also, having inherited the kingdom, conducted several sacrifices with brothers, friends and relatives.

40019802.author: पदार्थः
40019802.content: रामे Rama, राज्यम् kingdom, प्रशासति ruling, विधवाःwidows, न पर्यदेवयन् not there to lament, व्यालकृतम् of cruel animals, भयम् fear, नासीत् not there, व्याधिजम् disease, भयम् fear, न not

40019802.author: Translation
40019802.content: While Rama was ruling there was no lamentation of widows (over their loss), fear of cruel animals, or fear of disease.

40019803.author: पदार्थः
40019803.content: लोकः world, निर्दस्युःthieves, अभवत् not there, कश्चित् indeed, अनर्थम् lossन अस्पृशत् no harm, वृद्धाः aged, बालानाम् youngsters, प्रेतकार्याणि obsequies, न कर्वतेस्मnot do

40019803.author: Translation
40019803.content: There were no thieves, indeed there was no loss, aged did not perform obsequies (no deaths in the young population) for the young and no harm to people.

40019804.author: पदार्थः
40019804.content: सर्वम् all, मुदितमेव happy, आसीत् remained, सर्वः all, धर्मपरः followed the righteous path, अभवत् became, राममेव Rama alone, अनुपश्यन्तः looking at Rama, परस्परम् one another, नाभ्यहिंसन् not hurt

40019804.author: Translation
40019804.content: All were happy, and followed the righteous path, looking at Rama alone and no one hit another.

40019805.author: पदार्थः
40019805.content: रामे while Rama, राज्यम् kingdom, प्रशासति ruling, वर्षसहस्राणि thousand years, तथा like that, पुत्रसहस्रिणः thousand sons, निरामयाः free from trouble, विशोकाश्च free from sorrow, वसन् lived

40019805.author: Translation
40019805.content: While Rama was ruling for thousands of years, people were blessed with thousands of sons and lived free from trouble and sorrow.

40019806.author: पदार्थः
40019806.content: रामे while Rama, राज्यम् kingdom, प्रशासति ruling, रामःरामःरामःइति Rama, Rama, Rama saying so, प्रजानाम् people, कथाः stories, अभवन् spoke, जगत् world, रामभूतम् filled with, अभूत् filled

40019806.author: Translation
40019806.content: While Rama was ruling the kingdom, everything was Rama, Rama, and Rama. People spoke stories of Rama and the world was resonating with Rama.

40019807.author: पदार्थः
40019807.content: तत्र there, तरवः trees, नित्यपुष्पाः always in bloom, नित्यफलाः always bore fruits, निर्व्रणाः clouds sent down, पर्जन्यः rained, कालवर्षी when desired, मारुतः wind, सुखस्पर्शः delightful feeling

40019807.author: Translation
40019807.content: The trees were always in bloom, and always bore fruits. Clouds sent rain when desired. People lived with delightful feelings.

40019808.author: पदार्थः
40019808.content: ब्राह्मणा brahmins, क्षत्रियाः kshatriya, वैश्याः vaisyas, शूद्राः sudras, लोभविवर्जिताः free from avarice, स्वैः their, कर्मभिरेव avocations, तुष्टाः delighted, स्वकर्मसु in own work, प्रवर्तन्ते engaging in, रामे while Rama, शासति ruled, प्रजाः people, धर्मपराः remained righteous, आसन् pious, अनृताः lies, न not told

40019808.author: Translation
40019808.content: While Rama ruled brahmins, kshatriyas, vaisyas and sudras were free from avarice, were engaged in their own avocations and delighted. People remained righteous, pious, and never told lies.

40019809.author: पदार्थः
40019809.content: सर्वे all, लक्षणसम्पन्नाः richly endowed with good signs, सर्वे all, धर्मपरायणाः given to righteous behaviour, रामः Ram, दश ten, वर्षसहस्राणि thousand years, राज्यम् kingdom, भ्रातृभि: brothers सहितः with श्रीमान glorious, रामो Rama, अकारयत् ruled

40019809.author: Translation
40019809.content: All were endowed with signs of good culture, given to righteous behaviour. Rama ruled the kingdom for ten thousand years with brothers.

40019810.author: पदार्थः
40019810.content: धन्यं blessed, यशस्यम् fame, आयुष्यम् long life, राज्ञाम् kingdom, विजयावहं च and victory, पुरा earlier, वाल्मीकिना by Valmiki, कृतम् composed, आर्षम् noble, इदम् this, आदिकाव्यम् first epic, लोके in the world, यः he who, नरः human, पठेत् reads, शृणुयात् listens, पापात् from sin, प्रमुच्यते will be rid of

40019810.author: Translation
40019810.content: He who reads, listens to this first epic, a noble text composed by Valmiki will be blessed, attain fame, enjoy long life and victory in this world and will be rid of sins.

40019811.author: पदार्थः
40019811.content: धन्यं blessed, यशस्यम् fame, आयुष्यम् long life, राज्ञाम् kingdom, विजयावहं च and victory, पुरा earlier, वाल्मीकिना by Valmiki, कृतम् composed, आर्षम् noble, इदम् this, आदिकाव्यम् first epic, लोके in the world, यः he who, नरः human, पठेत् reads, शृणुयात् listens, पापात् from sin, प्रमुच्यते will be rid of

40019811.author: Translation
40019811.content: He who reads, listens to this first epic, a noble text composed by Valmiki will be blessed, attain fame, enjoy long life and victory in this world and will be rid of sins.

40019812.author: पदार्थः
40019812.content: रामाभिषेचनम् Rama's consecration, श्रुत्वा listens, लोके in this world, पुत्रकामः seeking son, मनुजः man, पुत्रान् sons, धनकामः desirous of wealth, धनानि च wealth, लभतेवै will obtain, राजा king, महीम् earth, विजयते conquers, रिपून् enemies, अधितिष्ठति च overcomes

40019812.author: Translation
40019812.content: On hearing about Rama's consecration, in this world, one who is seeking sons will get sons, one who is desirous of wealth will attain wealth, kings will overcome enemies and conquer earth.

40019813.author: पदार्थः
40019813.content: राघवेण Raghava, माता mother, यथा so also, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana's, सुमित्रा च Sumitra, भरतेन च by Bharata, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, तथा so also, स्त्रियःwomen, जीवपुत्राः living sons, पुत्रपौत्रसमन्विताः with sons and grandsons, सदानन्दाः ever happy, भविष्यन्ति will be

40019813.author: Translation
40019813.content: Women listening to Ramayana will have Kausalya's Rama, Sumitra's Lakshmana, Kaikeyi's Bharata as living sons and will be always happy and blessed with sons and grandsons.

40019814.author: पदार्थः
40019814.content: राघवेण Raghava, माता mother, यथा so also, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana's, सुमित्रा च Sumitra, भरतेन च by Bharata, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, तथा so also, स्त्रियःwomen, जीवपुत्राः living sons, पुत्रपौत्रसमन्विताः with sons and grandsons, सदानन्दाः ever happy, भविष्यन्ति will be

40019814.author: Translation
40019814.content: Women listening to Ramayana will have Kausalya's Rama, Sumitra's Lakshmana, Kaikeyi's Bharata as living sons and will be always happy and blessed with sons and grandsons.

40019815.author: पदार्थः
40019815.content: इदम् this, रामायणम् Ramayana, अक्लिष्टकर्मणम् of unwearied action, रामस्य Rama's, सर्वम् all, विजयंचैव victory, श्रुत्वा listens to, दीर्घम् long, आयुश्च life, विन्दति will be blessed

40019815.author: Translation
40019815.content: He who listens to Ramayana, the story of Rama of unwearied action will be victorious and blessed with long life.

40019816.author: पदार्थः
40019816.content: पुरा in the past, वाल्मीकिना Valmiki, कृतम् composed, इदंकाव्यम् this epic, यः he who, श्रद्धधानः with devotion, जितक्रोधःconquer anger, शृणोति listens, असौ will, दुर्गाणि difficulties, अतितरति overcomes

40019816.author: Translation
40019816.content: He who listens with devotion, this epic composed by sage Valmiki in the past, will conquer anger and overcome difficulties.

40019817.author: पदार्थः
40019817.content: पुरा in the past, वाल्मीकिना by Valmiki, कृतम् written, इदम् this, काव्यम् epic, ये whoever, शृण्वन्ति listens, ते to them, प्रवासास्ते united, बान्धवैःसह with relations, समागम्य united with, रमन्ते rejoice

40019817.author: Translation
40019817.content: Whoever listens to this epic written in the past by sage Valmiki will be united with relations and rejoice with them.

40019818.author: पदार्थः
40019818.content: ते they, राघवात् Raghava's, प्रार्थितान्, सर्वान् all, वरान् boons, इह here, प्राप्नुवन्ति will obtain, श्रवणेन by listening, सर्वे all, सुराः Suras, सम्प्रशृण्वताम् listen well, प्रीयन्ते pleased

40019818.author: Translation
40019818.content: Those who listen well to Ramayana will obtain all boons here in this world and all gods will be pleased.

40019819.author: पदार्थः
40019819.content: यस्य his, गृहे house, विनायकाः one who removes the obstacles in life, तिष्ठन्ति will be staying, शाम्यन्ति peace, राजा king, महीम् world, विजयेत conquer, प्रवासी those staying away from home, स्वस्तिमान् safe return, भवेत् will be

40019819.author: Translation
40019819.content: The god who removes obstacles will be staying in peace in the house where Ramayana is there. The kings listening to Ramayana will conquer the world and those gone out of home will return back safe.

40019820.author: पदार्थः
40019820.content: रजस्वलाः women prior to pregnancy, स्त्रियः women, श्रुत्वा listening, अनुत्तमान् best, पुत्रान् sons, सूयुः will deliver, पुरातनम् ancient, एनम् this, इतिहासम् old epic, पूजयन् च worship, पठन् च read, सर्वपापैः all sins, प्रमुच्येत will be rid of, दीर्घम् long, आयुः life, अवाप्नुयात् will attain

40019820.author: Translation
40019820.content: Women listening to Ramayana prior to pregnancy will deliver sons. This ancient epic if worshipped or read, one will get rid of all sins and attain long life.

40019821.author: पदार्थः
40019821.content: क्षत्रियैः by kshatriya, शिरसा head bent down, प्रणम्य offer salutations, द्विजात् by brahmins, श्रोतव्यम्, listen कृत्स्नम् earth, इदम् this, रामायणम् Ramayana, सदा always, शृण्वतः keep listening, पठतः reading, ऐश्वर्यम् kingship, पुत्रलाभश्च beget sons, भविष्यति in future, संशयः न no doubt

40019821.author: Translation
40019821.content: A kshatriya should always offer salutations with his head bent down before listening to Ramayana from a brahmin. Such a kshatriya will obtain kingship and also beget sons in future. There is no doubt.

40019822.author: पदार्थः
40019822.content: क्षत्रियैः by kshatriya, शिरसा head bent down, प्रणम्य offer salutations, द्विजात् by brahmins, श्रोतव्यम्, listen कृत्स्नम् earth, इदम् this, रामायणम् Ramayana, सदा always, शृण्वतः keep listening, पठतः reading, ऐश्वर्यम् kingship, पुत्रलाभश्च beget sons, भविष्यति in future, संशयः न no doubt

40019822.author: Translation
40019822.content: A kshatriya should always offer salutations with his head bent down before listening to Ramayana from a brahmin. Such a kshatriya will obtain kingship and also beget sons in future. There is no doubt.

40019823.author: पदार्थः
40019823.content: रामः Rama, सततम् ever, प्रीयते pleased, सः he, सनातनः eternal, विष्णुः Vishnu हि is, रघुश्रेष्ठः foremost of Raghus, रामः Rama, साक्षात् eternal, आदिदेवः Lord, महाबाहुः mighty armed, हरिः Hari, प्रभुः ruler, नारायणः Narayana, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, शेषः Sesha, उच्यते is said

40019823.author: Translation
40019823.content: Rama is said to be ever pleased with him who listens or reads the Ramayana daily. Foremost of Raghus, the mighty armed Rama is eternal Lord Vishnu himself. He is Hari, the ruler Narayana and Lakshmana is Sesha.

40019824.author: पदार्थः
40019824.content: एवम् in that way, पुरा ancient, वृत्तम् covered, एतत् all this, आख्यानम् narration, विस्रब्दम् trust, प्रव्याहरत read with devotion, वः you, भद्रम् be auspicious, अस्तु will, विष्णोः Vishnu, बलम् strength, प्रवर्थताम् grow

40019824.author: Translation
40019824.content: This way Ramayana is the ancient narration. Read it daily with trust and devotion. You be auspicious and let the strength of Vishnu grow in you.

40019825.author: पदार्थः
40019825.content: ग्रहणात् by grasping, तथा so also, श्रवणात् by listening, सर्वे all, देवाः च gods also, तुष्यन्ति delighted, रामायणस्य Ramayana's, श्रवणे by listening, पितरः ancestors, सदा always, तुष्यन्ति will be pleased

40019825.author: Translation
40019825.content: By grasping and listening to Ramayana, all gods will be delighted, ancestors will be pleased.

40019826.author: पदार्थः
40019826.content: ऋषिणा by the sage, कृताम् composed, इमाम् this, रामस्य Rama's, संहिताम् full of great meaning, भक्त्या with devotion, लिखन्ति च write this, तेषाम् for them, त्रिविष्टपे in the heaven, वासः will reside

40019826.author: Translation
40019826.content: Residence in heaven is assured for those who transcribe this Ramayana with devotion and full of meaning, composed by the great sage.

40019827.author: पदार्थः
40019827.content: महार्थम् great meaning, शुभम् auspicious, काव्यम् epic, श्रुत्वा listening, कुटुम्बवृद्धिम् growth of the family, धनधान्यवृद्धिम् augmentation of wealth, grains, मुख्याः mainly, स्त्रियश्च women also, उत्तमम् excellent, सुखं च comfort, भुवि on earth, सर्वाम् all, अर्थसिद्धिं च accomplishment of one's objects, प्राप्नोति will result.

40019827.author: Translation
40019827.content: Listening to this great auspicious epic will result in the growth of the family, excellent women, augmentation of wealth and grains and comfort on the earth and accomplishment of one's objectives.
